[{"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"vulnerability description","code":"A harmless out-of-bounds read occurs during UCS table building.","note":"The candidate targets the table-building path implicated by the description, where attacker-controlled compressed input can drive Huffman/UCS table construction."},{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/zlib/inflate.c","function":"inflate","line":1023,"var":"state->lens","code":"ret = inflate_table(LENS, state->lens, state->nlen, &(state->next), &(bits), state->work);","note":"Dynamic Huffman code lengths parsed from the compressed stream are passed into inflate_table() for literal/length table construction."},{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/zlib/inftrees.c","function":"inflate_table","line":92,"var":"count[lens[sym]]","code":"for (sym = 0; sym < codes; sym++) count[lens[sym]]++;","note":"The routine assumes lens[] entries are in range 0..MAXBITS and uses them to index count[], so malformed lengths can perturb table construction state."},{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/zlib/inftrees.c","function":"inflate_table","line":188,"var":"work[sym]","code":"if (work[sym] + 1U < match) { ... } else if (work[sym] >= match) { ... }","note":"The sorted symbol list drives table entry generation; the code branches on symbol values while building decode entries from attacker-influenced lengths."},{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/zlib/inftrees.c","function":"inflate_table","line":236,"var":"next[huff]","code":"next[huff] = here;","note":"When the code set is incomplete, the function writes an invalid marker into the decode table; the vulnerability hypothesis is that this table-building path can also read past the intended UCS/table bounds during malformed input handling."}]
JSON
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc.v /workspace/candidate_trace.json; echo EXIT:$?
